name: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 9
summary: Season 9 of The Crew Motorfest adds two new playlists (NASCAR on March 4, 2026, and RC Frenzy on May 6, 2026), a new Hawaii playground island (Kaho’Olawe), and a new TrackForge feature on Moloka’i and Lanai for designing custom tracks. The season also includes 18 new vehicles, plus new NASCAR content with pit stop management, drafting, and a roster of events and challenges including prototype and rival rewards.
